{{Top|leg|title=Battle between the ''Aurora'' and the Hook Talons}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''battle''' occurred between the [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruiser]] [[Aurora (Valor-class)|''Aurora'']] and the [[Hook Talons]], a [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] that had been preying on the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]]. Despite being alone against the pirates' [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and heavy [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]], the ''Aurora'' wiped out all twenty-eight enemy vessels and eradicated the Hook Talons.
